references.text: David prophesies about the Messiah and his sufferings, including being surrounded by evil men and regarded as a criminal.
The prophecy that the Messiah will be counted among lawbreakers, which is fulfilled in Jesus' crucifixion between two thieves.
Mark's account of the crucifixion, where Jesus is crucified alongside two thieves, demonstrating the fulfillment of prophecies.
Luke's description of the crucifixion, where Jesus is crucified with two criminals, emphasizing the fulfillment of Scripture's prophecies.
John's narrative of the crucifixion, where Jesus is crucified between two others, also pointing to the fulfillment of prophecies about the Messiah.
